entity: Bureau of Sport Fisheries and Wildlife, Acting Deputy Director
summary: The Bureau of Sport Fisheries and Wildlife's Acting Deputy Director viewed the environmental statement as a comprehensive document for protecting natural resources on Federal lands, but offered several conditional suggestions for improvement. These included adding definitions of key terms, clarifying ORV status on lands open to mineral entry, removing unnecessary economic impact descriptions, ensuring consistent open/closed policies across bureaus, and specifying concrete noise level standards in decibels at measured distances for different ORV types and use areas.
summary_quote: Bureau of Sport Fisheries and Wildlife, Acting Deputy Director - felt that environmental statement represented a comprehensive statement setting forth criteria for protection of natural resources on Federal lands. Suggested that statement include definitions of ORV, public lands, etc., and define status of ORV use on public lands which are open to mineral entry and established mining claims. Felt that much of the description of economic impacts in the statement is inappropriate and unnecessary. Pointed out that the "open or closed" policies of each of the bureaus should be consistent. Stated belief that completed studies on noise pollution contain enough information for definite acceptable noise levels to be spelled out, in decibels at measured distances, for different types ORV and outdoor public use areas;
